listings.name: Denel Mechem
listings.current_description: Denel Mechem, based in Lyttelton, Centurion, specializes in landmine detection, demining and explosive ordnance disposal, and has designed mine-protected vehicles such as the Casspir and Mamba. It also developed the Mechem Explosive and Drug Detection System (MEDDS) and has carried out demining and explosive-detection dog training work in countries including Angola and Namibia.

listings.name: JHPE Precision Engineering
listings.current_description: JHPE Precision Engineering is a CNC machining specialist in Lyttelton Manor, offering CNC turning, multi-axis milling, wire cutting and small-to-large batch machining across a wide range of materials for the defence, dental health, automotive and aerospace industries; the company moved into its current renovated 800 square metre Kruger Avenue facility in January 2016.

listings.name: Lesira Manufacturing (Pty) Ltd
listings.current_description: Lesira Manufacturing, trading as Lesira-Teq, is an OEM that designs, manufactures and supplies smart water meters from an ISO 9001:2015 and ISO 45001 certified facility in Koedoespoort that also houses a SANAS-accredited testing laboratory. With more than 20 years in water meter technology, the company has delivered over a million meters worldwide.

listings.name: Lynne's Wedding Services
listings.current_description: Lynne's Wedding Services offers non-denominational marriage-officer and pastoral services for weddings of all sizes, including legal ceremonies, christenings and bilingual (Afrikaans/English) ceremonies at venues across South Africa. Previously trading as 'Weddings with a Difference,' the business was a Gold Winner at the 2010 SABIA Vow Awards in the Marriage Celebrants category.

listings.name: Malibu Country Lodge
listings.current_description: Malibu Country Lodge is a country lodge near Roodeplaat Dam offering overnight stays and weekend getaways, with a swimming pool, spa, on-site restaurant and bar, pet-friendly grounds roamed by zebras and peacocks, and two conference and function venues catering for between 10 and 110 people; it received a 2017 Top Valued Establishment award.

listings.name: McCater Catering Supplies
listings.current_description: McCater Catering Supplies has been supplying the hospitality industry since 1999, stocking commercial kitchen equipment, tableware, cleaning supplies and kitchen staff clothing from its Equestria premises, which include a fully equipped demo kitchen where customers can see equipment in action. The company offers free delivery on orders over R500 within Pretoria and Johannesburg.

listings.name: Platō Coffee - Garsfontein
listings.current_description: This Garsfontein branch is part of Platō Coffee, a coffeehouse chain founded in Pretoria in 2019 that has grown into one of South Africa's largest, with around 150 locations across Southern Africa and the UK. The Garsfontein café offers free parking and serves coffee, iced lattes and moccachinos for eating in or takeout.

listings.name: Plexirenovations & Construction-Pretoria
listings.current_description: Plexirenovations & Construction is a Pretoria-based renovation and construction company operating out of Garsfontein, handling residential and commercial projects such as bathroom and kitchen renovations, home extensions, waterproofing and painting. The business takes on jobs of any size, from full home renovations to smaller structural upgrades, serving clients across the wider Pretoria area.

listings.name: Plug & Play Energy
listings.current_description: Plug & Play Energy is a solar and renewable energy company operating from Lyttelton Manor, Centurion, designing and installing electricity solutions for single homes, multi-tenant industrial complexes, retail environments, agricultural operations and solar farms. The company keeps a close eye on new solar technology to keep its installations current and its pricing competitive.

listings.name: QCheck
listings.current_description: QCheck Quality Control Services, part of the Q Group established in 2006, provides professional inspection, containment and ISO system implementation services - including a cloud-based Isoright Quality Management System - along with technical audits, procurement and quality assurance support for factories and manufacturers, notably in the automotive sector, from its Sinoville Centre office.

listings.name: Vusela Risk Services
listings.current_description: Vusela Risk Services is a security and risk management firm based in Irene, Centurion, operating since 2012, offering guarding, technical security systems (CCTV, intruder detection and access control), a national operations centre, AI-based virtual guarding, facial recognition, real-time crime monitoring and fraud and theft investigations for clients in retail, logistics, finance and mining.

listings.name: Clicks Monument Park
listings.current_description: Clicks Monument Park is a pharmacy and health and beauty retailer inside Monument Park Shopping Centre on Skilpad Road. The store trades Monday to Friday from 09:00 to 19:00, Saturday from 08:00 to 17:00, Sunday from 09:00 to 15:00, and 09:00 to 16:00 on public holidays.

listings.name: CQ Accountants
listings.current_description: CQ Accountants provides online accounting and tax services across South Africa from its Hennopspark, Centurion office, including monthly bookkeeping, payroll, tax planning and compliance, SARS dispute assistance, company secretarial and registration services, and annual financial statement compilation. The firm is registered with the South African Institute of Professional Accountants and SARS as tax practitioners.

listings.name: Irene Arms & Outdoor
listings.current_description: Opened in October 2022 inside the Irene Link Centre, this store combines a firearms and ammunition retailer with an outdoor and tactical gear shop, offering accredited firearm training, repairs and custom builds, plus two indoor ranges - including a 200m underground range said to be the only one of its kind in South Africa.

listings.name: Maxi Skips
listings.current_description: Maxi Skips offers mini skip hire for domestic and commercial waste removal from its Parktown Estate base, with 1 to 3 day, 7 day, 30 day and wait-and-load hire options plus optional labour to help fill the skip; its mini skips hold 2.5 tons / 2 cubic metres, suited to sites with limited space.

listings.name: Ompetha Power Projects
listings.current_description: Ompetha Power Projects is a Raslouw-based electrical construction company founded in 2007, CIDB Grade 8EP certified and B-BBEE Level 1, approved by Eskom, Ekurhuleni and City Power. It delivers turnkey MV/LV/HV infrastructure projects from 11kV up to 765kV, including distribution substations, power lines, overhead and underground reticulation, minisubs, transformers and fibre installations.

listings.name: PostNet Sinoville
listings.current_description: PostNet Sinoville is a courier and printing outlet at Sinoville Corner offering colour and wide-format copying and printing alongside domestic and international courier services, and it also serves as a DHL Service Point for parcel collection. It trades Monday to Friday 08:00-17:30 and Saturday 08:00-13:00, closed Sundays and public holidays.

listings.name: Qmuzik Technologies (Pty) LTD
listings.current_description: Qmuzik Technologies is a software development house headquartered in Centurion, founded in 1993, with more than 70 staff and an additional office in Cape Town. It builds enterprise resource planning, mobile, business process automation and supply chain software, and also provides campus management, business analysis and custom development services alongside hardware implementation and support.

listings.name: Cairnmead Health & Safety Consultants
listings.current_description: Cairnmead Health & Safety Consultants provides occupational health and safety consulting through three divisions - Operational Consultants (risk assessments, site audits, emergency planning), Industrial Consultants (audits and risk assessments for construction and industrial sites), and its Faculty of Safety, which offers accredited, CPD-bearing training in construction health and safety - from Waterkloof Corporate Park, Pretoria.

listings.name: CAPITAL SOFTWARE
listings.current_description: Capital Software is a payments and software technology company based in Hennopspark, Centurion, operating as a Reserve Bank-regulated Third Party Payments Processor and Systems Operator since 1968. It provides payroll, accounting, and collections software, payment and authentication technology, and prepaid card solutions (including the Capital Money Card and SlicPay Wallet) to corporate and public-sector clients.

listings.name: CRS Group (PTY) Ltd Centurion
listings.current_description: CRS Group (Pty) Ltd is a cloud-based accounting and management consulting firm founded in 2015, based in Centurion with a second office in Langebaan, offering cloud accounting, tax planning and compliance, payroll management, and financial reporting, integrating with platforms such as Xero, Sage and SimplePay. It is led by a qualified accountant and tax practitioner.

listings.name: Data4Every1
listings.current_description: Data4Every1 is a business solutions company based at Boardwalk Office Park in Faerie Glen, Pretoria, offering business intelligence and reporting dashboards, workflow automation, cybersecurity (in partnership with Bitdefender and Acronis), ERP systems including Dynamics 365 Business Central and Sage, payroll and HR solutions, farm management software, and business training, with an additional presence in Zambia.

listings.name: Denel Pretoria Metal Pressings (PMP)
listings.current_description: Denel Pretoria Metal Pressings (PMP), founded in 1931 and based at Lotus Gardens, Pretoria, is an integrated manufacturer of small- and medium-calibre ammunition, brass products, detonics, power cartridges and mining drill-bits, supplying military, police, hunting and sporting customers worldwide, with the Lotus Gardens ammunition facility forming a single value chain with PMP's Pretoria West foundry.

listings.name: DSV
listings.current_description: DSV is a major international logistics and supply chain group with operations in more than 90 countries, offering air, sea, road and rail freight, contract logistics and warehousing. This location is part of its South African network, which spans Johannesburg, Cape Town, Durban and Pretoria and covers customs clearance, courier delivery and cold chain logistics.

listings.name: DSV
listings.current_description: DSV is a major international logistics and supply chain group with operations in more than 90 countries, offering air, sea, road and rail freight, contract logistics and warehousing. This location is part of its South African network, which spans Johannesburg, Cape Town, Durban and Pretoria and covers customs clearance, courier delivery and cold chain logistics.

listings.name: MNF Steel (Pty) Ltd
listings.current_description: MNF Steel fabricates both stainless and mild steel products in Sunderland Ridge, handling around 25 tons of material a month with in-house cutting and bending. Its stainless work covers kitchens, food production and medical and architectural fittings, while its mild steel manufacturing supplies structural and industrial parts such as machine frames, platforms, brackets and tanks.

listings.name: Pro Arte Alphen Park Performing and Creative Arts High School
listings.current_description: Pro Arte Alphen Park Performing and Creative Arts High School is a government School of Specialisation in the arts, opened in January 1994 from the amalgamation of Pro Arte (founded 1969) and Alphen Park Commercial High School, offering focus areas in Dance, Art, Music, Drama, Hospitality and Enterprise Management, with an adjoining hostel for boarders.

listings.name: S A Business link and auto repair
listings.current_description: S A Business link and auto repair is an automotive workshop in Hermanstad offering mechanical repairs, suspension and steering work, body repairs, spray painting, brake and clutch services and vehicle diagnostics, positioned as a lower-cost alternative to dealership servicing. The business also offers a free local shuttle service for customers while their vehicles are serviced.

listings.name: Union Buildings
listings.current_description: The Union Buildings is the official seat of the South African government and the office of the President, built between 1910 and 1913 on Meintjies Kop to a design by Sir Herbert Baker in English monumental style, with terraced indigenous gardens, a 9,000-seat amphitheatre and a bronze statue of Nelson Mandela unveiled in 2013.

listings.name: Beefy Treats
listings.current_description: Beefy Treats, founded in 2011 by Joey Stofberg, is a healthy-snacks business at Fountain Square in Monument Park producing biltong, nuts and dried fruit under its Beefy Treats, Nutty Treats and Fruity Treats brands, distributing across Gauteng and nationally by courier, and partnering with the Pathways-Pretoria Studio NGO to employ young adults with disabilities in packaging.

listings.name: Cendev Projects C C
listings.current_description: Cendev Projects CC is a Midstream Estate-based construction and property development company offering a full building service from design and engineering through to construction and interior finishing. Its commercial work includes the Midlands Office Park and the extension and remodeling of the Midstream Spar, and it operates mainly in the Midstream, Midrand, Centurion, and Irene areas.

listings.name: Centurion Residential Estate
listings.current_description: Centurion Residential Estate is centred on Centurion Golf Estate & Country Club, a 160-hectare residential estate near Irene with an 18-hole golf course designed by Peter Matkovich that opened to the public in October 1997. The estate offers a restaurant, pro shop, and conference facilities for up to 120 delegates, but does not advertise guest accommodation.

listings.name: DTP562-Group
listings.current_description: DTP562 Group, established in 2011 and 100% Black owned and managed, is a distribution, logistics, development, facility services and construction company based in Olifantsfontein, Gauteng. Its divisions cover management consulting and recruitment, distribution and supply chain, construction and civil engineering, wholesale petroleum and coal distribution, facility management, security, environmental/waste management, bulk transport and engineering services.

listings.name: EMS Industries
listings.current_description: EMS Industries is a Lynnwood Glen-based embedded engineering company providing electronic and electro-mechanical design, telemetry and measuring/monitoring systems, software development and 3D CAD design, along with railway technology products (EOTs, HOTs, remote heads, repeaters and chargers) and industrial power supplies, operating across South Africa and countries including Canada, India, Lesotho, Mozambique, Sierra Leone and Eswatini.

listings.name: LANINO TRAFFIC MARKINGS
listings.current_description: Lanino Traffic Markings supplies and applies road-marking materials including cold plastic, thermoplastic, solvent-based and waterborne paint, plus rumble-drop markings and glass beads, and acts as the South African dealer for the Delta retro-reflectometer. The company holds an 8SK CIDB grading and has carried out marking work for SANRAL, provincial roads authorities and the City of Tshwane.

listings.name: Quality Pools
listings.current_description: Quality Pools has been designing and building fibreglass, gunite and concrete swimming pools from its Montana base since 1965, and is now run by the third generation of the same family. Alongside new pool construction across Pretoria, Johannesburg and Gauteng, the business handles pool renovations, spa pools and commercial aquatic facilities, backed by a 20-year warranty.

listings.name: RussellStone Foods
listings.current_description: RussellStone Foods is a protein and processed-meat business operating four brands: Creekside Farm (bacon, hams, sausages, pastrami and salami), Rica Meats (polony, russians and sliced cold meats), Pretoria Primal Traders (fresh and frozen carcasses) and a trading division supplying protein products domestically and internationally. The company manages its own cold chain from processing through to distribution.

listings.name: weDesiign Pty Ltd
listings.current_description: weDesiign is a one-team design and digital consulting agency in Irene, Centurion, offering website design, brand identity, software development, mobile apps, photography and brand marketing under a single roof, with a research-first process and transparent published pricing; established in 2020, it has completed roughly 1,000 projects for clients across South Africa and increasingly the UK.

listings.name: ACUDEO College Kirkney
listings.current_description: ACUDEO College Kirkney is an independent Grade R-12 school in Kirkney, part of the ACUDEO College group established in 2015, with facilities including science and computer laboratories, a coding and robotics class, sports courts and a swimming pool. The campus has maintained a matric pass rate above 94% over the past three years, reaching 98% in 2025.

listings.name: EVA
listings.current_description: EVA (Express Virtual Assistants) is an online platform, affiliated with Express Employment Professionals, that connects businesses with remote virtual assistants for hourly, pay-per-use support in areas including finance and accounting, IT, customer service, sales and marketing, admin, HR, and writing. Assistants are screened, vetted and trained before being matched with clients, with account managers providing ongoing support.

listings.name: Megavolt TV & Video
listings.current_description: Megavolt TV & Video has operated in Waverley since 2001, specialising in the sale, installation and repair of DSTV decoders and accessories and the restoration of TVs, VCRs, hi-fis and microwave ovens, and has more recently expanded into power inverter repairs, positioning itself as a hub for DSTV HD, XtraView and PVR systems in the Moot area.

listings.name: CompuBooks (Pty) Ltd
listings.current_description: Compubooks (Pty) Ltd, established in 2016 and based in a 4,700 sqm warehouse at the N4 Industrial Gateway Park in Pretoria East, supplies stationery, academic textbooks (including via a Pearson Publishing partnership), computing hardware and software, learning toys, sports and playground equipment, assistive devices, lab equipment, and office furniture, with a footprint across several South African provinces.

listings.name: Employers' Organisation for Hairdressing, Cosmetology, and Beauty (EOHCB)
listings.current_description: The Employers' Organisation for Hairdressing, Cosmetology, and Beauty (EOHCB) is a national employers' organisation, registered under the Labour Relations Act and representing salon and spa employers since 1947. It handles collective bargaining and CCMA/Bargaining Council representation on members' behalf, and offers training and guidance on labour law and health-and-safety compliance for the hairdressing, cosmetology and beauty industry.

listings.name: EW Serfontein & Associates Inc
listings.current_description: EW Serfontein and Associates Inc is a Pretoria-based law firm, with a second office in Knysna, specialising in conveyancing, civil litigation, commercial law, sectional titles, company law, debt collection, family law, RAF claims, insolvency and municipal disputes. Director Ernst Serfontein has practised commercial law for over 33 years and has served as an arbitrator for sectional title disputes.

listings.name: JJ Plates and Signs
listings.current_description: JJ Plates and Signs has been a recognised name in the number plate industry for more than 15 years, manufacturing number plates for all South African provinces alongside signage, vinyl printing, vehicle wrapping and screen printing; the Wonderboom South premises also offer key duplication, embroidery, vehicle licence disc renewals, roadworthy testing and a car wash and valet service.

listings.name: Marcé Fire Fighting Technology
listings.current_description: Marcé Fire Fighting Technology is a fire fighting vehicle manufacturer headquartered in Lyttelton Manor, Centurion, founded in 1997. It designs, builds and maintains fire fighting and airport rescue (ARFF) vehicles and offers turnkey fire station solutions from its 8,400 square metre Centurion manufacturing plant, producing up to 120 vehicles a year, and is ISO 9001:2015 certified.

listings.name: Mariammen Temple
listings.current_description: Mariammen Temple is Pretoria's oldest Hindu temple, built in 1905 in the Asiatic Bazaar area of Marabastad and dedicated to the goddess Mariamman. Its ornate gopuram entrance on 6th Street is considered one of the most impressive of its kind in South Africa, and the temple, home to Pretoria's Tamil League, was declared a national monument in 1982.

listings.name: Burgers Park
listings.current_description: Burgers Park is a botanical garden in central Pretoria, established in the 1870s and named after Thomas Francois Burgers, the fourth president of the South African Republic. It is a declared South African National Monument owned by the City of Tshwane, and features a statue of Burgers and a World War II memorial to the South African Scottish Regiment.

listings.name: EDB Hospitality & Events VIP Suites
listings.current_description: EDB Hospitality & Events VIP Suites is a Hennopspark-based corporate hospitality company offering private VIP suites at some of South Africa's most exclusive stadiums and venues, covering events such as rugby, soccer, cricket, golf, motorsport, horse-racing, polo, theatre and concerts, plus corporate functions and team building for groups of 5 to 500, alongside travel booking, branding and corporate gifting services.

listings.name: PostNet Pretoria CBD
listings.current_description: PostNet Pretoria CBD, based in Bothongo Plaza West on Francis Baard Street, handles courier and document services and is also known for assisting with Police Clearance Certificates, embassy deliveries and document apostille/authentication given its location near Pretoria's many embassies and government offices. It trades weekdays from 08:00 to 17:00 and Saturday mornings, closed Sundays and public holidays.
